'''Kevin Ch'ng''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 13 FL from Victoria, Aus.; Red 17 from Victoria, Aus. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

== Service ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Dates !! Service
|-
| August 1999 – January 2001
| [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] Gold 13, Calamari region; Victoria, Australia<ref name="decsq-calamari">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/calamari.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Calamari], decipher.com (listings August 1999 – January 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010110001600/http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/calamari.html Internet Archive]</ref>; earlier Red 17 (Victoria, Aus)<ref name="sm-fan">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], geocities.ws/plarathas (Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref>
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
